section_2_your_plan_hero.title: Your Plan Hero & Included Numbers
section_2_your_plan_hero.grid: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 mb-8 civr-rise
anatomy: Plan Header: Tier Badge (Starter/Basic $50/100m, Standard/Starter $75/250m, Pro $100/400m, Business $120/600m), Price, Expiry/Auto-renew Status
Allowance Progress Meters: Minutes Used vs Included, SMS Used vs Included
Numbers Included Counter (Main + Extras vs Limit)
Actions Bar: Upgrade CTA Button + Manage Plan Link
Demoted Sub-section: 'Numbers on this plan' list embedded directly under plan usage
section_2_your_plan_hero.tailwind_classes: lg:col-span-12 civr-card p-6 md:p-8 space-y-6 rounded-2xl border border-[var(--c-border)]

section_3_your_platform.title: Your Platform - Grouped by Job
section_3_your_platform.grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 mb-8 civr-rise
anatomy: Group A: Answer Calls (Call Forwarding, Voicemail, Ring Groups)
Group B: Make Calls (SIP Credentials, Outbound Quick IVR, Bulk Call)
Group C: AI Capabilities (AI Receptionist Agent, Text-to-Voice Relay, AI Summaries)
Group D: Connect & Utility (Fax on Business, Integrations, Webhooks)
section_3_your_platform.tile_state: Each tile clearly shows 'Included in Plan' (Set Up/Open) or 'Locked - Needs Pro/Business' (Upgrade CTA)

anatomy: USA Texting Number ($ price, Owned Count / Add button)
section_4_standalone_services.tailwind_classes: civr-card p-5 border border-[var(--c-border)] flex flex-col justify-between

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the React dashboard in JavaScript (.js) format under /app/frontend/src/cloudivr/pages/Dashboard.js.
Do NOT introduce new font families or custom raw colors outside the specified CSS variables and WCAG AA status accents.
Ensure total mobile responsiveness down to 390px viewport width.
Ensure all dropdowns, overlays, and header bars have non-transparent solid/blur backgrounds to avoid text overlapping.
Ensure every interactive button, input, toggle, card link, and metric card includes its dedicated data-testid attribute.
Remove any remaining 'Recent Activity' components on Home as instructed.
Group platform features explicitly into Answer Calls, Make Calls, AI, and Connect with clear visual distinction between included and locked states.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_slop: Avoid generic centered layouts and excessive uniform gradients. Use structured grids with generous internal padding.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.icons: Use lucide-react icons exclusively. Never use AI assistant emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.micro_interactions: Ensure every button and card has hover, active, and focus state feedback.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_readiness: All interactive elements must carry kebab-case data-testid attributes.
